slides.headline: SAM ALTMAN JUST TOLD ANTHROPIC'S CEO 'I AGREE' ABOUT SLOWING DOWN AI
slides.image_prompt: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei clasp hands across vivid orange-lit table mid-pact, faces brightly lit and clear, fierce rivals shocked by agreement, empty background, symbols only, extremely photorealistic and shocking.

slides.headline: NOBODY PUT THESE TWO ON THE SAME TEAM
slides.body:
OpenAI and Anthropic were supposed to be racing each other. Your whole picture of AI was built around these two being enemies.

Then Anthropic's CEO published an essay that changed the rules.

slides.headline: BOTH LABS AGREED TO HAND OUTSIDERS PERMANENT EMPLOYEE-LEVEL ACCESS
slides.body: On September 12, Dario Amodei published 'We Must Pace the Frontier': a call to slow the AI race and give outsiders permanent, employee-level access. Sam Altman read every word of it.

slides.headline: ALTMAN REPLIED: 'I AGREE'
slides.body: 13.2 million people read those two words

slides.headline: EVERY AI LAB JUST GOT A QUESTION THEY CAN'T IGNORE
slides.body:
You've watched these two companies race to build AI faster than anyone thought possible.

If the biggest labs stop racing, the rest have to answer why they're still running.

slides.headline: BOTH LABS JUST LOCKED IN PERMANENT OVERSIGHT
slides.body: Sep 12: Amodei's essay called for a slowdown Altman replied publicly: 'I agree' Altman: OpenAI had the same plan for weeks 2 labs now allow permanent outside access

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: SAM ALTMAN AGREED TO SLOW DOWN AI
slides.body: • Anthropic's CEO called for a slowdown • Altman replied 'I agree' for 13.2M to see • Both labs committed to permanent outside oversight Send this to whoever thinks AI is only going faster

caption:
Swipe to see the two biggest names in AI publicly agree to slow down the race they both started.

Sam Altman agreeing with Dario Amodei on AI pacing, Anthropic's 'We Must Pace the Frontier' essay, why OpenAI and Anthropic were expected to race each other, what permanent employee-level outside access actually means, Altman's public 'I agree' reply and its 13.2 million views, the pressure every other AI lab now faces, and what this stability signal means for businesses building on AI tools today.

The two people who launched the AI race just publicly called for slowing it down. That changes what every other lab must answer for, and signals that the AI tools businesses are building on today are here to stay.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: Sam Altman on X (Sep 12, 2026), Dario Amodei, 'We Must Pace the Frontier'

pinned_comment: The wild part: Altman said slowing down has been a primary topic at OpenAI for weeks already. They were planning this before Dario even published the essay.

candidates: SAM ALTMAN AGREED WITH ANTHROPIC THAT THE AI RACE NEEDS TO SLOW DOWN
SAM ALTMAN JUST TOLD ANTHROPIC'S CEO 'I AGREE' ABOUT SLOWING DOWN AI
hook_tournament.why: Candidate 1 uses 'JUST TOLD' and the direct quote 'I AGREE' to create urgency and feel like breaking news between rivals. Candidate 0 sounds corporate and flat despite being equally factual.

candidates: SAM ALTMAN JUST SIDED WITH HIS BIGGEST RIVAL ON SLOWING DOWN AI
SAM ALTMAN JUST TOLD ANTHROPIC'S CEO 'I AGREE' ABOUT SLOWING DOWN AI
hook_sharpen.why: 'I AGREE' gives you concrete proof of what he said. Naming the CEO with the exact quote beats a vague story about rivals agreeing.

specifics: Sam Altman publicly told his biggest rival 'I agree' about slowing down AI — on Twitter, in front of 13.2M viewers
Both companies promised to hand outsiders permanent, employee-level internal access to watch their AI work
Dario Amodei published an essay called 'We Must Pace the Frontier' calling for an industry slowdown
Altman says slowing down has been a 'primary topic' at OpenAI 'in recent weeks'
The tweet hit 58K likes and 13.2M views within hours

story.title: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great ide

editor_override: Cover image archetype mismatch: arm-wrestling communicates rivalry and competition — the exact opposite of the story's premise. A stranger seeing this at feed size for 1.7 seconds guesses 'feud story,' not 'surprise agreement.' The headline says 'I AGREE'; the image screams 'I WILL CRUSH YOU.' Fix: replace with an image that proves the agreement moment — a handshake composite between the two faces
gate_r: s7: Every bullet line renders a checkmark AND a stray '•' dot (e.g. '✓ • Anthropic's CEO…'), a broken-formatting artifact that must be stripped to one prefix per line.
